pay_hardtostaff_sped_009.evidence: Teachers who teach in Intensive Global Support 1 (IGS1), Intensive Global Support 2 (IGS2), Social Communication Support (SCS1 or SCS2 or SCS3), Social Emotional Support 1 (SES1), and Social Emotional Support 2 (SES2) classes shall be paid five one-hundredths (.05) of the individual teacher’s contracted salary.

pay_hardtostaff_other_011.evidence: Teachers who possess a current Bilingual and/or ESL endorsement shall receive a differential of $500.00 effective the beginning of the school year.
